camera_default: (a) whole ladder + all 4 climbers in the HUD-free band
orientation: 38 deg vertical FOV, 18 deg look-down, game yaw (looking down -Z)
why_not_mid_ladder: with plain lookAt the band centre (263.5) is 70 px above screen centre; aiming at the mid-ladder point overflows the band bottom by 64 px
mid_ladder_alt: keep the camera aimed at mid_ladder_point and use camera.setViewOffset to shift the image 70 px (667-high) down

option_c_busy_top.frames: ladder z>=14 m + hatch landing only
